failure_history: The full Workbench typecheck detected a timer type incompatibility in the earlier shared transport edit. An explicit Node timer import alone remained insufficient; removal of unref corrected it. The final complete Workbench typecheck and actual child-termination transport test passed.
Pi fixture reads accept six sources and reject eight; several rejected fixtures are intentionally invalid and others rely on naming/fallback behavior that Core does not implement.
limits: Core size target and complete upstream synthesis remain unfinished.
Directory traversal caps processed entries but readdir allocates one directory name vector before that cap. A streaming directory iterator remains pending.
No OS sandbox or elimination of local-process filesystem races.
Remote skill installation, watchers, broad dialect compatibility and automatic plugin loading remain pending.
Actual GUI evidence covers development VSIX Webview and native Workbench, not a packaged desktop installer.
No live-model or Windows runtime verification.
